## Problem

What user-facing problem or maintenance need does this address?

## Change

Describe the focused change and any intentionally excluded work.

## Verification

List commands and scenarios actually run, results, and checks not performed. For documentation-only changes, check links and claims against source.

## Visual evidence

Include relevant before/after screenshots for interface changes. Remove this section when not applicable.

## Risks and recovery

Describe data, API, secret-handling, dependency, or deployment implications and how to revert. State when none apply.
